acceptance_predicates.description: Each unavailable baseline or candidate field is attributed to the correct side without duplication.
Top-level comparability agrees with required provenance and unavailable reasons.
Reports contain digests and typed reasons, never credentials or raw provider responses.

definition_of_done: Focused asymmetric and symmetric comparison tests pass.
Independent exact-head review and hosted checks pass.

inputs.description: Existing task acceptance, evidence requirements, and development-only constraints.

outputs.description: Strict-schema task specification and generated coordination projections.

gates.description: All existing acceptance predicates and definition-of-done checks pass without weakening thresholds.
